title: Propagated beyond-VRAM case: a 120 um silicon-nitride pillar-array lens lit by a plane-wave pulse, a downsampled six-component output plane at three wavelengths, an angular-spectrum focal objective and the dense epsilon VJP through the streamed plane adjoint on the RTX 5880

fixture.device: Square array of cylindrical pillars (epsilon 4.0, silicon nitride at 1.55 um) on a 1.0 um period, 0.6 um tall, in air with no substrate. The radius of each pillar is the hyperbolic lens phase of a 150 um focal length at 1.55 um wrapped onto 0.15 to 0.42 um; the array is lens-like and its focusing efficiency is not claimed. The geometry is rasterized on cell centres into the epsilon tensor (no project structures).
fixture.source: soft Ex plane sheet at z = -0.8 um spanning the lateral CPML (extend_through_pml), Gaussian pulse of 15 fs power FWHM centred at 30 fs, carrier 1.55 um; the source envelope ends at 84.7 fs
fixture.monitor: z-normal FieldMonitor at z = +0.6 um (0.4 um above the pillar tops), 120 x 120 um, downsample 8 (0.4 um samples, 300 x 300 points, sin(theta_max) = 1.55/0.8 covers every propagating angle), six components, DFT at 1.65, 1.55 and 1.45 um
fixture.objective: sum over the three wavelengths of |E|^2 on the axis 150 um beyond the monitor plane, evaluated by torchfdtd.angular_spectrum.propagate_points (pad 3) on the plane spectrum divided by dt x steps so that FP32 seeds stay of order one
fixture.design_variable: dense cell-centred epsilon (float32, 381,030,400 values); the design slab is the pillar layers 24 to 35

execution.mode: streamed, DifferentiablePlaneSimulation over StreamedSimulation, fused CUDA tiles, synchronous transfers
execution.restart_journal: none: the streamed spectral path rejects a restart journal (torchfdtd.streamed._journal), so the run is unjournaled and a crash means rerunning it; crash and resume are covered by docs/validation/beyond_vram_restart_5880.json

planner.source: python -m benchmarks.beyond_vram_propagated --footprint 120 --duration-fs 175 --checkpoints 2 --host-gib 100 --plan --assume-5880 (metadata only, resources of the workstation as recorded in beyond_vram_restart_5880.json)

physical_vram.live_adjoint_state_bytes: 5 state banks x 11.05 GB plus the dense parameter reservation 12.19 GB = 67.4 GB, above the 51.5 GB of physical VRAM
physical_vram.resident_alternative: a resident adjoint holds one primal and one adjoint E/H state, epsilon, its inverse and the gradient (60 bytes per cell, 22.9 GB) plus 11.05 GB per checkpoint; with the two checkpoints of this schedule it would need 45 GB and 267 block replays, with three 56 GB; the public resident path also refuses scenes above eight million cells
physical_vram.statement: The E/H state of one bank (9.1 GB) does not exceed physical VRAM; the live state of the adjoint at the declared checkpoint schedule does. This case therefore meets the program's requirement in the working-set sense only, which the record states plainly.

fixture.wall_time_model: benchmarks.beyond_vram_propagated.TIME_MODEL, fitted on compact-host-large-5880.json and compact-host-capacity-5880.json: forward 493 s, backward 4023 s, two finite-difference forwards 985 s, total 5501 s (1.53 h); the fit scatters by about 30 percent on those records

rehearsal.modes: resident (AdjointOptions checkpoints 8 on host) and streamed (slab width 32, temporal depth 16, checkpoints 2, local checkpoints 1, host banks, 6 GiB host and 1.5 GiB GPU budgets) on the local RTX 3060
rehearsal.supplementary: a 24 um streamed-only member (520 x 520 x 64, 17.3 million cells, 172,800 observers, W=32, K=16, C=4, L=1) with the one-sided difference, docs/validation/g5/G5-05_rehearsal_3060_streamed_24um.json; not judged by this case

reference_method: Directional central finite difference of the same objective along the pillar direction delta (indicator of the pillar cells whose centres lie within 10 um of the axis, over the design slab), two extra streamed forwards on the workstation and in the rehearsal; in the rehearsal the resident DifferentiablePlaneSimulation on the same grid, sources, monitor and objective is the second reference for the objective and the design-slab gradient.

observables.name: objective
observables.definition: sum over the wavelengths of the on-axis focal intensity

observables.name: focal_intensity_per_frequency
observables.definition: the three terms of the objective

observables.name: plane_electric_energy_per_frequency
observables.definition: |E|^2 integrated over the plane quadrature at each wavelength

observables.name: energy_history
observables.definition: per time step, the sum of squares of the electric Yee samples feeding the plane interpolation (artifact streamed_energy_history.npy)

observables.name: energy_peak_step, energy_rise_step, energy_decayed_fraction
observables.definition: argmax of the history, first step above 1e-3 of the peak, final value over the peak

observables.name: gradient_norm, design_slab_gradient_norm, gradient_nonzero
observables.definition: L2 norms of the dense VJP and of its pillar-layer slab (artifact streamed_design_slab_gradient.npy), count of nonzero entries

observables.name: directional_derivative, finite_difference, relative_error, relative_response
observables.definition: sum of the gradient over the direction cells, (J(eps + h delta) - J(eps)) / h or the central form, |fd - d| / |d|, |delta J| / J

observables.name: frequency_resolution_hz, source_amplitude_ratio
observables.definition: 1 / duration; amplitude spectrum of the sampled source waveform at each wavelength over its peak

propagation.justification: Exploratory streamed forwards of 12 um and 20 um members of the same family reached 1.7e-4 and 2.1e-4 at 160 fs and about 1.5e-4 at 175 fs; the limit leaves a factor of about six for slower lateral leakage of the larger array. A tail of 1e-3 in energy is 3 percent in field amplitude, the truncation error accepted for the spectrum.

spectrum.justification: 1 / 175 fs = 5.71 THz against the 11.72 THz between 1.65 and 1.55 um (0.487); the source amplitude at the three wavelengths is 0.80, 0.99 and 0.75 of its peak.

gradient.justification: The step changes the pillar index by 0.6 percent over 316 pillars (2.2 percent of the array) on the workstation and over all 196 pillars in the rehearsal. Both contexts use the central difference: the 14 um rehearsal gave a central relative error of 9.1e-3 at a 26 percent response, while the supplementary 24 um streamed run showed that the one-sided difference at this step carries a 14.7 percent truncation error at a 1.9 percent response (the pillar transmission is strongly nonlinear in epsilon near its resonances), so the one-sided form first declared for the workstation was replaced by the central form before the judged run at the cost of one more forward. The workstation keeps the 5 percent originally declared for it and the rehearsal the program's 3 percent physical-parameter threshold. A response below 2e-4 of the objective would sit near the FP32 floor of a 1836-step spectrum and is declared inconclusive (FAIL).

resident_agreement.applies_to: rehearsal only; the workstation run has no resident reference

acceptance.source_of_limits: fixture-specific budgets declared here; resident agreement from proposed_thresholds.discrete_dimensionless_fp32

not_yet_covered: the workstation run itself: tests/test_beyond_vram_propagated.py judges the rehearsal record and the report rendering; the RTX 5880 record must be rendered with benchmarks/report_beyond_vram_propagated.py --context workstation and recorded by the maintainer
a restart journal on the spectral path

an E/H state that exceeds physical VRAM by itself: at the recorded streamed throughput such a case (at least 2.1 billion cells at this duration) needs about six times the declared three-hour budget and disk banks with tens of terabytes of traffic

notes: Applicability: the rehearsal verifies the driver, the criteria machinery, the resident/streamed agreement and the central finite difference at 1/58 of the cells on the local RTX 3060 shared with other agents; it does not verify the workstation run, so G5-05 stays NOT_RUN until the RTX 5880 record is judged in the workstation context. The 1.2 to 1.6 billion cell target of the brief was reduced to 381 million cells: host banks of five states plus eight dense parameter copies exceed the 103 GB admissible on the workstation above about 0.45 billion cells with this schedule, and the fitted wall-time model gives 1.39 h here against a declared budget of 3 h. Exploratory probes before this declaration: resident 12 um at 2600 steps and streamed 20 um at 2518 steps for the energy decay, and an 8 um, 300-step run of the driver in both modes (finite-difference relative error 5e-4 at a 2.9 percent response, resident/streamed gradient relative L2 3.9e-7). The case was added in the commit following 73203d2 together with the driver; before any judged run, the workstation finite difference was changed from one-sided to central (commit after 3b0deb0) on the evidence of the supplementary 24 um streamed rehearsal (one-sided relative error 0.147 at a 0.019 response); no limit was relaxed and the wall-time estimate grew by one forward to 5501 s.
